tefra_add_library(tefra_audio
    SOURCES src/audio_system.cpp src/sound_driver.cpp src/sound_math.cpp src/clip.cpp
            src/backend_miniaudio.cpp src/backend_null.cpp
    PUBLIC_DEPS tefra_runtime
    PRIVATE_DEPS tefra_miniaudio)
# Source tree fallback for "builtin:<name>" in development builds (the copy below is the normal location).
target_compile_definitions(tefra_audio PRIVATE TEFRA_SOURCE_DIR="${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}")

# Built-in sound effects (resources/sfx, generated by scripts/gen_sfx.py) next to every executable:
# <build>/bin/resources/sfx, which is where exe_dir() + "resources/sfx" looks.
add_custom_target(tefra_sfx_resources ALL
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/sfx
            ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/resources/sfx
    COMMENT "Copying built-in sound effects")
